about.title: About Better Life Care
about.story_title: Care You Can Trust. Standards You Can Rely On.

about.standards_text: What sets Better Life Care apart is our commitment to combining warm, compassionate care with the precision, professionalism, and reliability associated with German standards. services.title: Our Services
services.intro: Professional, personal care delivered at home, with clear communication for the whole family.

elderly_care.title: Elderly Care and Daily Living Support
elderly_care.tagline: Dignified everyday support with consistent supervision.
elderly_care.description: Help with the daily routines that make a home feel safe and familiar, delivered with patience, respect, and steady supervision, so your loved one keeps their independence and dignity.

home_nursing.title: Home Nursing and Advanced Procedures
home_nursing.description: Qualified nurses provide professional care and procedures in the comfort of home, following clear safety and hygiene routines and the instructions of the treating physician.
features: Injections and IV therapy as prescribed

post_hospital.title: Post-Hospital and Chronic Care Programme
post_hospital.tagline: Smooth recovery and reliable long-term follow-up.
post_hospital.description: A structured programme that helps patients settle back at home after hospital stays and supports long-term conditions with consistent, dependable follow-up.
features: Care plan built around the doctor's discharge instructions

rehabilitation.title: Rehabilitation at Home
rehabilitation.tagline: Restore mobility and independence, safely at home.
rehabilitation.description: Guided rehabilitation in familiar surroundings, focused on regaining movement, strength, and confidence step by step.
features: Support after surgery, injury, or stroke [CONFIRM scope]
Progress tracking shared with the family

diagnostics.title: Home Diagnostics and Doctor Visits
diagnostics.tagline: Trusted diagnostics and medical oversight, without leaving home.
diagnostics.description: Through trusted partners, we arrange laboratory tests, diagnostics, and doctor visits at home, so medical oversight is easy and stress-free for the patient and family.
features: Home sample collection through partner laboratories
Doctor home visits through partner providers
Coordination of results with the care team
Scheduling that fits the patient's routine

caregiver.title: Caregiver and Companion Services
caregiver.tagline: A caring presence, when you need one.
caregiver.description: Trained caregivers and companions who bring reliability, conversation, and comfort, giving families peace of mind when they cannot be there.
features: Help with daily activities and outings

foot_care.title: Advanced Foot Care
foot_care.tagline: Gentle, professional care for healthy, comfortable feet.
foot_care.description: Specialized foot care at home for those who need extra attention, such as older adults and people with long-term conditions, delivered by trained professionals with a strong focus on hygiene and safety.
features: Guidance on daily foot care and footwear
Referral to a doctor when needed

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Better Life Care – Senior & Home Care Services, Egypt
privacy.intro: Better Life Care respects the privacy, dignity, and confidentiality of every client and family we serve.
privacy.collection: To arrange and provide senior and home care services, we may collect contact, home, identity, emergency contact, health, care, payment, and doctor instruction information.
privacy.use: We use personal information only as needed to assess and arrange care, assign professionals, maintain care records, coordinate visits and services, communicate with authorized family members, respond to emergencies, process payments, and meet applicable legal requirements.
use_items: Assess and arrange appropriate home or senior care.
Assign caregivers, nurses, or other care professionals.
Prepare and maintain care plans and service records.
Coordinate appointments, home visits, medicines, and health services.
Communicate with clients and authorized family members.
Meet applicable health, legal, and regulatory requirements.
privacy.medical: Medical and health information is treated as sensitive and confidential. Access is limited to authorized people and healthcare professionals who need it to provide or coordinate care.
privacy.sharing: We do not sell clients' medical or personal information. Where necessary and lawful, information may be shared with healthcare providers, trusted partners, emergency services, and authorized family members.
privacy.security: Better Life Care takes reasonable administrative, organizational, and technical measures to protect personal and medical information from unauthorized access, loss, disclosure, alteration, or misuse.
privacy.rights: Subject to applicable Egyptian law, clients may request access to or correction of their personal information and exercise applicable data protection rights, including withdrawing consent where processing relies on it.
privacy.contact: For privacy questions or concerns, contact Better Life Care – Senior & Home Care Services, Egypt. Phone: [Phone Number]. Email: [Email Address]. Address: [Business Address].
